title: Ultra-fast pulsar found near the Milky Way’s supermassive black hole
summary: Scientists scanning the heart of the Milky Way have spotted a tantalizing signal: a possible ultra-fast pulsar spinning every 8.19 milliseconds near Sagittarius A*, the supermassive black hole at our galaxy’s core.
